reflection: Volume-attention factors (NVDA/MSFT/AAPL volume z-scores) are the only ones with repeated positive signs, helping 2023 and 2025 but hurting 2022 and 2024; no pair has beaten the sum of its parts. Return-based and intraday-position factors flip sign across regimes. Longer windows (60d) and sign-multiplying destroyed the volume signal. I will try volume measures that are scale-free across regimes (QQQ volume, volume relative to its own longer-run level, volume changes), and volume combined with volatility state so the effect does not flip between high-vol 2022 and low-vol 2024.

lessons.name: peer_volume_surge_mean
lessons.lesson: Averaging NVDA and MSFT volume z-scores kept the 2023/2025 gains and 2022/2024 losses, so combining them added no stability.

lessons.name: nvda_volume_surge_60d
lessons.lesson: A 60d baseline made the surge a slow level measure that lost the short-term attention signal and only helped in 2023.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_peer_vol_ratio
lessons.lesson: Ratio of Apple to QQQ volatility is a noisy rescaling of Apple vol that hurt in 2022 and 2024 and helped neither model.

lessons.name: qqq_return_zscore_10d
lessons.lesson: Z-scoring QQQ's return was a near-copy of QQQ_return_1d and added only noise.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_vs_peer_volume
lessons.lesson: Apple's volume surge relative to NVDA's helped both models in 2023 and 2025 but failed in 2022 and 2024, making it the best but still regime-dependent volume signal.

lessons.name: aapl_minus_msft_cum_3d
lessons.lesson: Three-day relative performance vs MSFT overlaps Apple's own short momentum and its sign flips across regimes, so gain was negligible.

factors.name: aapl_volume_vs_peer_volume_5d_smooth
factors.hypothesis: The daily version is noisy and failed in 2022/2024; smoothing volume over 3 days should reduce single-day spikes and give a steadier attention-gap signal.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge
factors.hypothesis: NVDA volume is idiosyncratic and drove the 2022/2024 failures; QQQ volume is a broader market-activity baseline so the Apple-specific volume excess should be more stable.

factors.name: qqq_volume_change_signed_by_trend
factors.hypothesis: Short-vs-long market volume activity captures regime shifts in participation (capitulation or calm) not covered by any factor so far.

factors.name: aapl_high_vs_prev_close_gap
factors.hypothesis: Compares upside vs downside excursion from yesterday's close using high and low, a skew in intraday extremes that return and range factors miss.

factors.name: aapl_volume_surge_vol_state
factors.hypothesis: The volume signal changes meaning between high-vol (2022) and low-vol regimes; a market vol-state variable lets models condition on it, complementing the volume gap.

factors.name: aapl_minus_qqq_with_volume_confirm
factors.hypothesis: Apple's relative move matters differently when attention (NVDA volume) is high; the interaction gives the model the conditional relation that additive terms cannot.
